$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-110 — curated player name aliases keyed by STABLE EXTERNAL IDENTITY.
Each entry names a source registry key (data/reference/sources.json) plus that
source's stable external identity for one person, exactly as stored in
external_identities.external_id. For `afltables` that is the canonical profile path
Entries are NEVER keyed by players.id: the surrogate is re-seeded by a clean rebuild.
player_name_aliases, resolving each identity through external_identities to exactly
one player and failing closed when it resolves to none or to more than one.
search_alias is derived by afldb_normalise_name() in SQL. Loading is idempotent and
only ever inserts: it never deletes or rewrites other alias rows.
These are established identity facts, recorded by hand. Nothing here is inferred
from chronology, age, games, IDs or duplicate ordering, and the loader contains no
